title: Member Chat approved-organization report never loads its comparison config
surface: Hosted Store v0.2.546 native Member Chat acceptance report and organization transport gate
role_context: Real signed-in ordinary member; canonical admin check returned zero rows for the current extension user.
organization_context: Native checked organization and both Chat request-header fingerprints agreed at 8c4b25f5099470bf; no device override was persisted. The approved config was not loaded in the member driver, so the approved-organization comparison was unevaluated.
permission_context: Actual Ask mode; two authenticated Chat turns accepted by the backend with HTTP 200.
preconditions: Exact Store v0.2.546 candidate from guarded hosted run 39154980480, artifact 12146922392.
Existing non-admin account signs into web and extension, then selects a current organization in the native picker.
reproduction: Run the guarded member-chat case and inspect its private reviewer-chat-store report from run 39154980480.
Observe account.selected_organization_fingerprint and both Chat request-header fingerprints agree; both turns complete with HTTP 200.
Observe chat_transport.organization_header_matches_approved=false, despite the separate approved-config fingerprint triangulation, because the member path never loads approvedOrganization.
expected: The member runner loads the private approved-organization config, proves the checked UI UUID equals its approved ID, and reports true only when the actual Chat request header equals that same ID. Missing config or mismatched values fail acceptance.
actual: The driver loaded approvedOrganization only for the admin UNINTERRUPTED path, while the hosted member wrapper did not stage that private config. The member report therefore emitted false from a null comparison and did not make an approved-config assertion.
reproducibility: One guarded native run exhibits the false report field; source inspection identifies the deterministic missing member config load and missing hosted staging branch.
severity: S2: member organization evidence is inaccurately reported and the approved-config check is absent from the native gate; no organization product defect is established.
priority: P1: repair the current Member Chat acceptance boundary before a new Store verdict.
cause: approvedOrganizationConfig() was called only when UNINTERRUPTED was true, and the hosted member-chat case did not stage or pass the private approved-organization file. The generic transport snapshot compared its header to null and returned false.
sibling_census: The admin UNINTERRUPTED path already loads and checks the private approved organization. The normal member path had only checked UI selection versus actual request headers; opening and follow-up both used that selected organization. The visible-answer paint failure is separately owned by EXT-D-0240.
reviewer: Fresh independent source peer PASS; native pending.
acceptance_criteria: Hosted member runner stages a mode-0600 private approved-organization config in its isolated runtime and removes it after execution.
Member driver reads that exact runtime config and compares the checked UI UUID fingerprint and actual start request header against its approved ID; a missing or different value fails.

Fresh peer verifies forcing RED on removed staging, child env forwarding, runtime loading and a hardcoded true comparison, then one guarded exact-Store native retest proves both headers, terminal replies, visible answer, and resource finals.

verification.source: Candidate source adds private hosted staging, child path forwarding, member config load, checked-UI comparison, and actual-header assertion. The actual production source seams are exercised with in-memory removed-staging, removed-forwarding, removed-loading, and hardcoded-true mutants that fail the named proof. Focused organization tests 6/6 pass; full focused suite, compile and scoped Biome passed before this final test addition.
verification.native: Run39158481456 stopped before driver launch with hosted_profile_org_secret_required. Resource finals valid, child failed. No Chat replies, organization headers or paint evidence; zero product credit.

limitations: The approved-config fingerprint was triangulated outside the failed member process; that process did not load the config, so the original run cannot count as approved-config proof.
The original run failed visible-answer proof at an opacity-zero ancestor. This separate defect repair cannot grant Member Chat product acceptance.
No hosted/native retry or release has been run on the candidate source.
next_action: Complete fresh peer review of preflight fixture presence and bounded source-admission records, then one guarded exact-Store member retest. Do not infer product behavior from setup refusal.
